critic.fix_suggestion: Replace the single solid grey block on the fuselage side with an array of 12 small rectangular planes. Each plane should have a width-to-height ratio of 3:1, spaced 0.5 units apart along the horizontal axis of the fuselage to create a continuous window line.

discrepancies.observed: A single solid grey block or missing detail on the fuselage side
discrepancies.reference: A continuous horizontal line of small, individual rectangular windows
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: replace with a repeated array of small cubes/planes

discrepancies.observed: A single dark block at the nose
discrepancies.reference: Four distinct panes arranged in a wrap-around cockpit configuration
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: split into 4 separate planes with slight angles

discrepancies.observed: No visible vertical break or seam on the forward fuselage
discrepancies.reference: A clear vertical line and recessed rectangular shape for the main boarding door
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: add a thin, slightly inset plane to create a vertical seam

discrepancies.observed: Smooth continuous fuselage surface at the rear
discrepancies.reference: A distinct large rectangular outline near the tail section
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: add a large rectangle with an inset depth
